rule: regional_candidate_record_key is unique
limitation: One row is one origin by frame by atomic market by language audit cell.

rule: Each regional_frame_key plus candidate_key maps to exactly one source_origin_key and each source_origin_key maps to exactly one candidate_key
limitation: Mirrors and language rows cannot create extra candidates.

rule: Count distinct candidate_key by regional_frame_key
limitation: Only rows with rights_and_access_decision_complete true may complete the frame.

rule: independent_source_family_audit_state is AUDITED_INDEPENDENT or AUDITED_SAME_FAMILY or AUDITED_MIRROR
limitation: Every candidate must receive one audited state.

rule: Count distinct source_family_key by regional_frame_key where independent_source_family_audit_state is AUDITED_INDEPENDENT
limitation: Mirrors versions and shared origins do not add a family.

rule: structured_preference_or_sensory_candidate equals mode_b_structured_preference_or_liking OR mode_c_controlled_or_semi_controlled_sensory_outcome
limitation: Boolean values are lowercase true or false.

rule: industry_or_professional_language_candidate equals mode_d_professional_or_industry_language
limitation: Boolean values are lowercase true or false.

rule: user_generated_or_community_source_candidate equals mode_a_user_generated_sensory_language OR source_class in FORUM_OR_COMMUNITY_PLATFORM USER_REVIEW_PLATFORM OFFICIAL_PLATFORM_UGC_API
limitation: Equality prevents both false-negative governance bypass and false-positive threshold inflation.

rule: source_class is ACADEMIC_STUDY OPEN_DATA_REPOSITORY GOVERNMENT_OR_INSTITUTIONAL_DATA INDUSTRY_OR_PROFESSIONAL_BODY SOURCE_AUTHORED_BLOG_OR_STATIC_SITE PRODUCT_OR_REVIEW_DATASET FORUM_OR_COMMUNITY_PLATFORM USER_REVIEW_PLATFORM OFFICIAL_PLATFORM_UGC_API or DATA_ON_REQUEST_STUDY
limitation: A source may use the narrowest applicable class; mirrors retain their origin class.

rule: Xiaohongshu Zhihu Douban Weibo Dcard PTT Reddit Home-Barista CoffeeGeek Naver Daum DCInside and comparable platforms require a community source_class and user_generated_or_community_source_candidate true
limitation: Name comparison is case insensitive and aliases are documented.

rule: rights_and_access_decision is CLEARED_OPEN_LICENSE CLEARED_PUBLIC_DOMAIN CLEARED_OFFICIAL_API_FOR_DECLARED_USE CLEARED_WRITTEN_PERMISSION RESEARCH_ONLY_NONCOMMERCIAL METADATA_ONLY DATA_REQUEST_PREPARED BLOCKED_ACCESS BLOCKED_AUTOMATION BLOCKED_COPYRIGHT BLOCKED_PRIVACY BLOCKED_MODEL_USE or BLOCKED_LICENSE_UNCLEAR
limitation: PUBLIC_HTML is never a rights decision.

rule: rights_state is CLEARED RESTRICTED BLOCKED or UNRESOLVED
limitation: A complete block decision may use BLOCKED; unresolved cannot complete the regional frame.

rule: access_state is PUBLIC_VERSIONED OFFICIAL_API WRITTEN_PERMISSION REQUEST_ONLY METADATA_ONLY PUBLIC_HTML_OBSERVABLE_ONLY BLOCKED or NOT_APPLICABLE
limitation: Factual public visibility grants no reuse or model-use permission.

rule: model_research_use_state is ALLOWED RESEARCH_ONLY_NONCOMMERCIAL DERIVED_ONLY PENDING_PERMISSION BLOCKED or NOT_APPLICABLE
limitation: Pending or blocked may still be a complete audited decision when the final decision is not admission.

rule: Community candidates use exactly one allowed community decision; non-community candidates use NOT_APPLICABLE
limitation: PUBLIC_HTML is never a forum or community decision.

rule: AUTHORIZED_API maps to CLEARED_OFFICIAL_API_FOR_DECLARED_USE or RESEARCH_ONLY_NONCOMMERCIAL; WRITTEN_PLATFORM_PERMISSION and WRITTEN_AUTHOR_PERMISSION map to CLEARED_WRITTEN_PERMISSION; OPEN_LICENSED_SNAPSHOT maps to CLEARED_OPEN_LICENSE; DERIVED_ONLY_AUTHORIZED requires a cleared general decision and model_research_use_state DERIVED_ONLY; METADATA_ONLY DATA_REQUEST_PREPARED BLOCKED_AUTOMATION BLOCKED_COPYRIGHT BLOCKED_PRIVACY and BLOCKED_MODEL_USE map to the identically named general decision
limitation: A community authorization label cannot contradict the general rights decision.

rule: rights_and_access_decision_complete equals true only when rights decision rights_state other than UNRESOLVED access_state model_research_use_state license_or_terms license_or_terms_url rights_evidence_url access_path and decision_basis are populated with allowed values and all applicable community crosswalk or request rules pass
failure_effect: Candidate does not enter completeness numerator
limitation: NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_BASIS is allowed only where a URL or term genuinely does not exist and decision_basis explains why.

rule: Count distinct candidate_key whose every frame row has rights_and_access_decision_complete true divided by all distinct candidate_key values in the frame
limitation: Required value is exactly 1.0000.

rule: forum_or_community_decision is AUTHORIZED_API WRITTEN_PLATFORM_PERMISSION WRITTEN_AUTHOR_PERMISSION OPEN_LICENSED_SNAPSHOT DERIVED_ONLY_AUTHORIZED METADATA_ONLY DATA_REQUEST_PREPARED BLOCKED_AUTOMATION BLOCKED_COPYRIGHT BLOCKED_PRIVACY or BLOCKED_MODEL_USE for community rows
limitation: No generic PUBLIC_HTML decision.

rule: DATA_REQUEST_PREPARED requires contact_target exact_requested_fields requested_date_range raw_text_requirement derived_only_alternative privacy_protections intended_model_research_use public_release_boundary deletion_or_withdrawal_procedure request_status DATA_REQUEST_PREPARED and request_sent false
limitation: No request is sent without explicit user authorization.

rule: request_status is NOT_APPLICABLE NOT_PREPARED DATA_REQUEST_PREPARED AUTHORIZED_TO_SEND or SENT
limitation: AUTHORIZED_TO_SEND and SENT require a later explicit user authorization record.

rule: request_sent is false unless a later explicit user-authorized action and evidence commit are recorded
limitation: This governance commit authorizes preparation only.

rule: privacy_state is NOT_APPLICABLE AGGREGATE_NO_PERSONAL_DATA DEIDENTIFICATION_REQUIRED DEIDENTIFIED REVIEW_REQUIRED or BLOCKED
limitation: Public visibility does not resolve privacy; countable UGC requires DEIDENTIFIED.

rule: admission_state is NOT_ADMITTED ADMITTED_METADATA_ONLY or ADMITTED_FOR_DECLARED_EVIDENCE_ROLE
limitation: Metadata-only admission produces no countable document response sample or training unit.

rule: training_eligibility_state is NOT_ADMITTED PENDING ELIGIBLE_FOR_DECLARED_ROLES or INELIGIBLE
limitation: Eligible corpus roles do not imply gold labels canonical promotion or population estimates.

rule: eligible_corpus_roles is NOT_APPLICABLE or a semicolon list limited to REGIONAL_LANGUAGE_CORPUS PREFERENCE_LANGUAGE_CORPUS AMBIGUITY_TEST_SET and REGION_HELD_OUT_TEST
limitation: A role requires separate rights privacy provenance and source-fit review.

rule: An admitted community source requires username profile email avatar exact personal location and unnecessary direct link exclusions comments or replies separate review and pseudonymous document keys
limitation: All eight privacy booleans must be true.

rule: Forum review and blog evidence defaults sensory_gold_label_eligible canonical_concept_promotion_eligible and population_preference_estimate_eligible to false
limitation: Any later true value requires a separate evidence decision.

rule: regional_candidate_record_key exists in regional_source_candidate_register.tsv and candidate_key source_origin_key source_family_key regional_frame_key source_market_region and language_tag exactly match that candidate row
limitation: Evidence units cannot change a candidate's region language family or origin identity.

rule: admitted_source equals true only when the linked candidate admission_state is ADMITTED_FOR_DECLARED_EVIDENCE_ROLE
limitation: A self-reported evidence-unit boolean cannot override candidate admission.

rule: rights_cleared_for_declared_role equals true only when the linked candidate rights decision and model_research_use_state authorize the exact evidence or training role
limitation: Blocked pending metadata-only or incompatible noncommercial rights cannot be promoted by an evidence-unit row.

rule: privacy_cleared_for_declared_role equals true only when linked candidate privacy_state is NOT_APPLICABLE AGGREGATE_NO_PERSONAL_DATA or DEIDENTIFIED and every applicable UGC privacy guard passes
limitation: Privacy-pending or blocked material never becomes countable.

rule: countable true equals admitted_source AND rights_cleared_for_declared_role AND privacy_cleared_for_declared_role AND successful duplicate control
limitation: Rights-blocked privacy-pending duplicate or metadata-only material never becomes a document response sample or training unit.

rule: LANGUAGE_DOCUMENT maps to REGIONAL_LANGUAGE_DOCUMENT_COUNT; UNIQUE_EXPRESSION maps to REGIONAL_UNIQUE_EXPRESSION_COUNT; PREFERENCE_RESPONSE maps to REGIONAL_PREFERENCE_RESPONSE_COUNT; SENSORY_SAMPLE maps to REGIONAL_SENSORY_SAMPLE_COUNT; TRAINING_ELIGIBLE_UNIT maps to REGIONAL_TRAINING_ELIGIBLE_UNIT_COUNT
limitation: REGIONAL_SOURCE_FAMILY_COUNT is derived from contributing countable units rather than its own unit type.

rule: evidence_unit_key is unique and source_local_unit_key plus unit type is deduplicated within one source origin
limitation: Raw repeated rows do not create effective units.

rule: region_key plus sequence_within_region is unique and sequence starts at 1 with no gaps
limitation: Counters are never shared across regions.

rule: A batch qualifies for the no-gain counter only when both search booleans are true and both corresponding scope and evidence-path fields are populated
limitation: A global or single-lane search is insufficient.

rule: material_gain is true when any positive audited delta advances an unmet regional candidate family required-class explicit-mode rights-completeness admission or training-eligible-unit gate
limitation: The regional outcome ledger records each delta; raw row growth alone is not material gain.

rule: Counter increments from the immediately preceding regional batch only when current material_gain is false and both searches are evidenced; material gain or either missing search resets counter to 0; first qualifying no-gain batch sets counter to 1
limitation: An intervening ineligible batch breaks the consecutive sequence.

rule: An unmet regional lane may stop only when consecutive_targeted_no_material_gain_count is at least 2
limitation: A completed threshold frame need not invoke the no-gain stop.

rule: Every summary delta resolves to regional_acquisition_outcome_ledger.tsv and register_evidence_path identifies the committed regional register version
limitation: Later register additions do not rewrite earlier batch outcomes.

rule: regional_outcome_key is unique and regional_batch_id resolves to exactly one regional batch with the same region_key
limitation: candidate_key is NOT_APPLICABLE only for an aggregate metric row; otherwise it resolves to the regional register.

rule: metric_key is named_source_candidate_count audited_independent_source_family_count structured_preference_or_sensory_candidate_count user_generated_or_community_source_candidate_count industry_or_professional_language_candidate_count explicit_mode_audit_count rights_and_access_decision_complete_count admitted_source_count or training_eligible_unit_count
limitation: Raw row count is not a material-gain metric.

rule: value_before_batch value_after_batch and delta are nonnegative numeric values and delta equals value_after_batch minus value_before_batch
limitation: Negative corrections require a separate corrective batch and cannot be hidden.

rule: Each new count in a batch row equals the sum of matching positive deltas in regional_acquisition_outcome_ledger.tsv and material_gain_basis enumerates exactly the positive contributing metric keys
limitation: Self-reported batch summaries cannot override outcome rows.

rule: One aggregate cell is keyed by regional_frame_key source_market_region language_tag data_mode source_family_key preparation_scope roast_scope black_or_milk_scope consumer_or_professional_scope training_eligibility_role and reported_measure_key
limitation: Source-local scales and modes remain unpooled.

rule: coverage_cell_key resolves to one aggregate cube cell; EVIDENCE_UNIT membership resolves to one evidence_unit_key; CANDIDATE membership resolves to one candidate_key; SOURCE_FAMILY membership resolves to one source_family_key
limitation: Exactly one membership identity applies per row and must match reported_measure_key.

rule: coverage_membership_key is unique and duplicate cell by membership identity rows are prohibited
limitation: One unit cannot be counted twice in the same cell.

rule: included true requires a countable evidence unit for the six admitted measures; CANDIDATE_AUDIT_RECORD_COUNT instead requires a complete audited candidate and never an evidence unit
limitation: Candidate-frame audit coverage and admitted evidence coverage remain distinct.

rule: Largest top-three and effective-family measures are calculated separately for each region and reported_measure_key using one declared countable unit type
limitation: Zero denominator is NOT_COMPUTABLE_ZERO_UNITS.

rule: REGIONAL_TRAINING_ELIGIBLE_UNIT_COUNT is reported per eligibility role and as a deduplicated union of evidence_unit_key across roles
limitation: Multi-role membership does not create extra units in the union.
